shortDescription: Manages licenses in a BIG-IQ registration key pool

options.name: accept_eula
options.description: A key that signifies you accept the F5 EULA for this license. A copy of the EULA can be found here https://askf5.f5.com/csp/article/K12902 This is required when C(state) is C(present).

options.name: addon_keys
options.description: The addon keys to put in the pool.

options.name: license_key
options.description: The license key to put in the pool.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: regkey_pool
options.description: The registration key pool in which you want to place the license. You must give your registration pools unique names. While BIG-IQ does not require this, this module does. If you do not, the behavior of the module is undefined and you may end up putting licenses in the wrong registration key pool.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the regkey license in the pool on the system. When C(present), guarantees the license exists in the pool. When C(absent), removes the license from the pool.
